听.title: BBC 6 Minute English: Climate change and extreme weather (Ep.260903)
听.body: Phil: Every year we see damage, death and destruction caused by hurricanes, cyclones and typhoons. Is climate change making this impact worse? Sarah: Those are large rotating storm systems formed over warm tropical waters. As the world warms, scientists think these storms will get more destructive. Darren: If a storm moves more slowly, there will be more likelihood of flooding, landslides and mudslides. (Vocabulary: likelihood 可能性 / landslide 山体滑坡 / mudslide 泥流 / storm surge 风暴潮 / casualty 伤亡)
听.zh: 菲尔：每年飓风、旋风和台风都造成破坏与伤亡，气候变化是否让影响更糟？萨拉：这些是温暖热带洋面上形成的大型旋转风暴系统……随着全球变暖，科学家认为风暴将更具破坏性。达伦：若风暴移动更慢，发生洪涝、山体滑坡与泥流的可能性更高。（词汇：likelihood 可能性 / landslide 山体滑坡 / mudslide 泥流 / storm surge 风暴潮 / casualty 伤亡）

说.title: 口语话题：AI时代，品牌如何讲"人的故事"？
说.body: Topic: 'In an age where AI can generate any content, what makes a brand story truly human and worth sharing?' Prepare a 2-minute spoken response. Tips: 1) Give one real brand moment that moved you. 2) Explain why emotion, not information, made it stick. 3) Use at least two of these words: vulnerability, resonance, authenticity, connection.
说.zh: 口语话题：'在AI能生成任何内容的时代，什么让一个品牌故事真正有人味、值得分享？' 准备一段2分钟口头表达。建议：1）举一个真正打动你的品牌瞬间；2）说明为什么是'情绪'而非'信息'让它被记住；3）至少用到 vulnerability（脆弱）/ resonance（共鸣）/ authenticity（真实）/ connection（连接）中的两个词。

读.title: 阅读：AI时代营销的"重构·新生"——TopDigital创新营销盛典（China Daily）
读.body: At the 14th TopDigital Innovation Marketing Summit, speakers argued that as AI makes content production ever more efficient, brands need to understand consumer emotion and build deep connections. 'AI can create content, but meaning still comes from people,' one speaker noted, as marketing shifts from 'capturing attention' to 'creating emotional value'. LaiFen's Romeo added that going global requires answering why consumers choose you and why they trust you — value, not just lower price, earns repeat choice.
读.zh: 在第十四届TopDigital创新营销盛典上，嘉宾指出：当AI让内容生产越来越高效，品牌更需要理解消费者情绪、建立深层连接。'AI能创造内容，但意义仍来自人'，营销正从'获取注意力'走向'创造情绪价值'。徕芬Romeo补充：出海要回答消费者为何选你、为何信你——真正带来复购的是价值，而非更低价格。

写.title: 写作任务：Write about a brand moment that moved you
写.body: Write 150-200 words on: 'Describe a marketing campaign or brand action in the past year that genuinely moved you — and explain why it worked on an emotional level, not just a functional one.' Use a clear opening line, two supporting points, and a closing reflection. Avoid jargon like 'ecosystem' or 'empower'.
写.zh: 写作任务：写150-200词，主题'描述过去一年里真正打动你的一个营销活动或品牌行动，并解释它为何在情绪层面而非仅功能层面奏效'。要求：清晰的开头句、两个支撑点、一句收尾反思。避免 ecosystem、empower 等套话。

练.title: 词汇与语法：情绪价值 & "from A to B" 渐进结构
练.body: Vocabulary: emotional value (情绪价值), resonance (共鸣), authenticity (真实感), attention (注意力). Grammar drill: 'from X to Y' shows progression. Build 3 sentences using the pattern, e.g. 'Marketing is shifting from capturing attention to creating emotional value.' Then replace X and Y with your own marketing ideas. Bonus: turn one sentence into a headline under 8 words.
练.zh: 词汇：emotional value（情绪价值）/ resonance（共鸣）/ authenticity（真实感）/ attention（注意力）。语法：'from A to B' 表渐进，造3个句子，如'营销正从获取注意力走向创造情绪价值'，并把A、B换成你自己的营销想法。进阶：把其中一句改写成不超过8词的标题。
